grade.first_issue: None; the proof is complete and correct.
grade.summary: The submission proves termination using a well-founded lexicographic descent of the number of entries greater than 1 and the total prime-factor count. It then identifies the primewise gcd of all valuations as an invariant and reconstructs the unique terminal integer from these invariants. Both requested conclusions follow rigorously.
strengths: Correctly computes the valuation transformation as (a,b) ↦ (min(a,b),|a-b|).
Provides a valid lexicographic descent argument covering all possible cases of a move.
Correctly proves that a terminal board has exactly one entry greater than 1.
Establishes the primewise gcd invariant via the Euclidean algorithm.
Correctly reconstructs M and shows that it depends only on the initial board.
